download.lead: Ori Studio runs in your browser with nothing to install. The desktop app is the same workspace, packaged for macOS, Windows and Linux — with native menus and file dialogs, projects that open straight from Finder or Explorer, and updates that install themselves.
download.openInBrowser: Or open it in your browser
download.title: Download Ori Studio

which.linuxBody: The .deb installs on Debian and Ubuntu and their relatives. The AppImage runs anywhere without installing: make it executable and launch it.
which.macBody: Apple Silicon for any Mac with an M-series chip; Intel for the ones before. The download button picks Apple Silicon by default, because a browser cannot tell the two apart.
